metadata.title: On solutions to tropical Monge-Ampère equations
metadata.abstract: This paper develops convex analysis on tropical varieties and investigates the properties of the tropical Monge-Ampère equations. We start by introducing notions of plurisubharmonic functions and Kähler forms on arbitrary tropical varieties. We show that many classical results of pluripotential theory extend to this setting, including an analogue of Demailly's regularization theorem. Next, we study the solutions to the tropical Monge-Ampère equations. While we establish their uniqueness, we show that the existence is not guaranteed in general. More precisely, we prove that the tropical analogue of the Calabi-Yau theorem fails for any pair $(X, \theta)$ consisting of a compact tropical variety $X$ of dimension at least two satisfying a mild genericity assumption, and a tropical Kähler form $\theta$ on $X$. In particular, there exist measures compactly supported in the open part of $X$ that admit no solution. In contrast, for tropical varieties that are regular in codimension one, we show the existence of solutions. Finally, via strongly faithful tropicalizations whose existence is established in this paper, we relate the tropical solutions, when they exist, to the solutions of non-Archimedean Monge-Ampère equations on Berkovich spaces.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 在热带簇上建立多重势论和正则化工具，证明热带 Monge–Ampère 解的唯一性，并在一般性条件下构造高维 Calabi–Yau 类比失败的测度。
techniques: 忠实热带化与 Berkovich 空间
analysis.breakthrough: 同时给出存在性失败机制及余维一正则情形的正面存在结果。
analysis.limitations: 反例和存在定理处于不同几何假设；不能笼统宣称热带 Monge–Ampère 总不可解或总可解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者称数学想法、结果和证明均来自作者，但偶尔使用 LLM 辅助英文语法；语言辅助仍计入明确披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 对经典、热带和非阿基米德势论的对应关系有重要边界澄清。
